lines.text: SNIPER! GET DOWN!
WHERE IS HE?! WHERE IS HE?!
CHECK THE ROOFS!
THE BALCONY! HE IS ON THE BALCONY!
THEY ARE COMING! AFTER HIM!
FALL BACK! THE COURTYARD! BACK TO BACK!
lines.say: Отходим! Во двор! Спина к спине!

lines.text: SPLIT UP! CHECK THE ALLEYS!
Close up! Watch the corners!
Back to back! He is close!
Eyes open, check your sector!
Hold the line, don't let him flank us!
lines.say: Держать строй, не дайте ему обойти!

lines.text: Stay tight! Shoot anything that moves!
lines.say: Не расходиться! Стрелять во всё, что движется!

lines.text: He's picking us off, keep together!
lines.say: Он выбивает нас по одному, держитесь вместе!

lines.text: Watch the roofs!
Eyes up! Check the roof edges!
Nobody leaves this circle!
He is up there somewhere, hold!
Cover your sector, shoot anything that shows!
lines.say: Прикрывайте сектор, стреляйте во всё, что появится!

lines.text: INTRUDER ON BOARD. ALL DECKS. SEAL THE SHIP.
lines.say: Нарушитель на борту. Всем палубам. Закрыть корабль.

lines.text: CITY GUARD: THE VEIL HAS FAILED. ALL CITIZENS, GO HOME AND STAY INDOORS.
lines.say: The Veil has failed. All citizens, go home and stay indoors.

lines.text: @COMMANDER: NO. YOU ARE FAR TOO INTERESTING TO WASTE.
lines.say: No. You are far too interesting to waste.

lines.text: @COMMANDER: TAKE HIM ALIVE. PUT HIM IN A CELL.
lines.say: Take him alive. Put him in a cell.

commander_count_rest: of my soldiers, in a single morning. Killed by a boy with one good arm.
commander_count_many: So many of my soldiers, in a single morning. Killed by a boy with one good arm.
